proposed.text: A private company with 120 employees wants to understand its PWD employment obligations. Under the Philippine law framework, which statement correctly describes the company's obligation?

options.text: It must reserve exactly 1% of positions for PWDs as an absolute legal mandate under RA 10524
It is encouraged to reserve at least 1% of positions for PWDs under RA 10524 and anti-discrimination provisions
It has no legal obligation to hire PWDs since employment quotas apply only to government agencies
It must reserve 5% of positions for PWDs since it is a large private employer with over 100 employees

proposed.rationale: Private companies with 100+ employees are encouraged (not strictly mandated) to reserve 1% of positions for PWDs. The 1% employment quota is a firm absolute mandate for government agencies and corporations under RA 10524. For private companies with 100 or more employees, the 1% reservation is encouraged and backed by anti-discrimination provisions, but the framing in RA 10524 and RA 7277 amendments is less absolute for the private sector than for the public sector. Failure to make good-faith efforts can trigger anti-discrimination enforcement, but the private sector framing is 'encouraged' rather than a hard criminal mandate.
proposed.explanation: Government: 1% is an absolute mandate. Private (100+ employees): 1% is encouraged with anti-discrimination backing.
